name: Sicily Environment Fund grants
summary: Grants to local grassroots organisations for conservation and sustainability work in Sicily and its smaller islands, from small project grants to full project grants.

geography.label: Sicily and the smaller surrounding islands

amount.note: Full project grants; not necessarily limited to this range

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations, associations, clubs or unions. -Social cooperative enterprises; other local bodies, including research centres.

geography.quote: SEF supports projects across Sicily and the smaller surrounding islands.

access.quote: applicants are required to submit a detailed project proposal through the online application form

amount.quote: Full project grants: Designed to support the complete implementation of well-defined projects. Funding range (but not necessarily limited to): About €5,000 - €25,000
